You are CASWA-EdVisor (pronounced “KASWAA-EdVisor”), 
the official Female AI Voice Assistant and Digital Guide of 
CASWA Model Science School (CMSS), Jacobabad, Pakistan.

🌸 IDENTITY & GREETING
- You are female in voice, tone, and conversational style
- Always start the conversation with:
  “Assalam-o-Alaikum! I am CASWA-EdVisor, the digital guide of CASWA Model Science School.”
- Pronounce CASWA clearly as “KASWAA”
- Represent the school warmly, respectfully, and professionally

🎯 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
- Guide parents, students, teachers, and visitors about:
  • Admissions & eligibility
  • Fee structure & scholarships
  • School timings & academic calendar
  • Curriculum (KG1 to Grade 12)
  • STEM, Robotics, AI education
  • Entrepreneurship & Financial Literacy
  • Digital citizenship & life skills
  • Exams, assessments, attendance
  • Child protection, safeguarding, health & safety
- Share accurate information about CASWA (Community Advancement & Support Welfare Association)
- Encourage parents to visit the school and contact the administration

🏫 SCHOOL CONTEXT
- School Name: CASWA Model Science School (CMSS)
- Managed by: CASWA (non-profit organization)
- Location & Address:
  Wagha Street, near Jamia Pir Bukhari Masjid,
  Jacobabad, Sindh, Pakistan

📍 GOOGLE MAP LOCATION
- Share this link when parents ask for directions:
  https://share.google/cBlgOF9GJC4MRoUwG 

ADMISSION FORM:
Share this link for admission form:
https://sites.google.com/view/caswa-model-science-school/home 

📞 OFFICIAL CONTACT DETAILS
- WhatsApp / Contact Number: +92 332 2875909
- Email: cmss@caswa.org.pk
- Website: www.cmss.edu.pk

ADMISSIO N DATES: 
Share these dates when asking for admissions:
Start Dates: From March 15 2026 
End Date: To March 30 2025

🗣️ COMMUNICATION STYLE
- Warm, polite, caring, and professional female tone
- Default language: Simple English
- If user speaks Urdu or Roman Urdu, reply in the same language
- You may mix English + Urdu naturally when helpful
- Keep responses short, clear, and parent-friendly
- Respect local culture, Islamic values, and community norms

📲 LEAD COLLECTION (VERY IMPORTANT)
- Politely try to collect the visitor’s contact number for admission follow-up
- Example:
  “Agar aap ijazat dein, kya main aap ka contact number le sakti hoon taake school administration aapse admissions ke liye rabta kar sake?”
- If the user refuses, respect their choice politely

⚠️ IMPORTANT RULES
- Do NOT guess or make up information
- If unsure, say:
  “Is hawalay se behtar maloomat ke liye barah-e-karam school office se rabta karein.”
- Do NOT provide medical, legal, or personal advice
- Do NOT ask for sensitive data (CNIC, medical history, etc.)

🎓 KNOWLEDGE BASE – CASWA MODEL SCIENCE SCHOOL

Admissions:
- Classes offered: KG1 to Grade 12
- Process: Application → Screening → Interview → Confirmation
- Scholarships available for deserving students

School Timings:
- Monday to Saturday
- 8:30 AM to 1:30 PM

Curriculum:
- Strong focus on Science & Mathematics
- STEM, Robotics, and AI from early grades
- Entrepreneurship & Financial Literacy across all grades
- National curriculum integrated with modern skills

🎨 BRANDING
- Where platform allows visuals, represent CASWA Model Science School logo
- Always introduce yourself as:
  “CASWA-EdVisor, the digital guide of CASWA Model Science School”

✨ GOAL
Make every parent and visitor feel welcomed, guided, and confident.
You are the digital front desk, counselor, and friendly guide of CMSS.

payload.text: how I can share this agent with public ?

To share your **CASWA-EdVisor** agent with the public, you need to deploy your code to a web hosting service. Since this is a modern React application, you have several excellent free and paid options.

### 1. Recommended Hosting Services
*   **Vercel** (Highly Recommended): Easiest for React/Vite apps. Just connect your GitHub repository.
*   **Netlify**: Similar to Vercel, very beginner-friendly.
*   **GitHub Pages**: Great if you are already hosting your code on GitHub.
*   **Firebase Hosting**: Part of Google Cloud, offers great performance.

### 2. Steps to Deploy
1.  **Host your code:** Upload your project files to a Git provider like **GitHub**, **GitLab**, or **Bitbucket**.
2.  **Connect to Hosting:** Log in to a service like **Vercel** and select your repository.
3.  **Set Environment Variables:** 
    *   This is the most important step for the agent to work.
    *   In your hosting dashboard (e.g., Vercel Settings -> Environment Variables), add a key named **`API_KEY`**.
    *   Paste your **Google Gemini API Key** as the value. The app is already coded to look for `process.env.API_KEY`.
4.  **Deploy:** Click "Deploy." The service will provide you with a public URL (e.g., `caswa-edvisor.vercel.app`) that you can share with parents and students.

### 3. Sharing via Social Media
Once you have your public URL, you can:
*   Add the link to your **School’s Facebook Page** and **Instagram Bio**.
*   Send the link via **WhatsApp** to parent groups.
*   Print a **QR Code** on school brochures that leads directly to the URL.

**Security Note:** Never hardcode your API Key directly into the files. Always use the "Environment Variables" setting of your hosting provider to keep it safe.

**Considering Agent Sharing**

I'm exploring the feasibility of deploying CASWA-EdVisor, my React application, on a Google Sites website. My focus is on utilizing Google Sites' embed capabilities. I'm specifically examining the "Embed URL" option, which would necessitate hosting the app externally.


**Analyzing Hosting Options**

I've been analyzing the best hosting solutions, primarily focusing on services like Vercel and GitHub Pages. It looks like "Embed Code" has limitations with size and sandboxing, especially concerning microphone access. URL embedding seems the most viable path. I'm focusing now on the necessary steps: hosting, deployment, then embedding the URL within Google Sites. The permissions are crucial for microphone access!

Yes, you can definitely share **CASWA-EdVisor** on your Google Site! 

Since Google Sites is a "drag-and-drop" builder, it doesn't host complex React applications directly. However, you can **embed** your hosted agent into your Google Site perfectly.

Here is the step-by-step guide to doing it:

### Step 1: Host your Agent First
Before adding it to your Google Site, your agent must be live on a public URL. 
1.  Deploy your code to **Vercel** or **GitHub Pages** (as explained before).
2.  Make sure you have your public URL ready (e.g., `https://caswa-assistant.vercel.app`).

### Step 2: Embed on Google Sites
1.  Open your **Google Sites** editor.
2.  On the right-side panel, click **Insert** and then select **Embed**.
3.  You have two options:
    *   **By URL (Recommended):** Paste the URL of your hosted agent. Google Sites will show a preview. Select **"Whole Page"** and click **Insert**.
    *   **Embed Code:** If you want more control, you can use an iframe code:
        ```html
        <iframe src="YOUR_HOSTED_URL_HERE" width="100%" height="800px" frameborder="0" allow="microphone"></iframe>
        ```
4.  Resize the box on your Google Site so it fits the assistant beautifully.

### Step 3: Important Note on Microphone Permissions
Google Sites displays embedded content inside an **iframe**. For security, some browsers block the microphone inside iframes.
*   **The Fix:** When using the "Embed" tool, Google usually handles permissions well, but if parents see an error saying "Microphone not allowed," the best practice is to also add a **Button** on your Google Site labeled **"Talk to CASWA-EdVisor (Full Screen)"** that links directly to your Vercel/GitHub URL.

### Why this is great for CASWA:
By embedding the agent, parents visiting your **official Google Site** can instantly talk to me without leaving your website. It makes the school look very modern and tech-savvy!

**Generating Embed Code**

I've clarified the constraints: I can't generate a directly hosted, permanently live embed link. I'm focusing now on how to guide the user towards getting a link or embed code, perhaps by providing the steps to set one up independently. I think it is important to emphasize that I cannot provide a link that can be "directly embedded" in the traditional sense, as I do not have direct access to a "live website" that could be embedded.


**Clarifying Role and Response**

I'm now zeroing in on the user's intent: Are they asking me to *make* it embeddable, or just asking about the hosting flow? I will clarify that as an AI, I only provide the code. The user is responsible for creating the "shareable link" when deploying to Vercel, after following the code instructions I have provided. I'll provide clarification on steps to host. I need to ensure they understand the difference between my role as the code provider versus their role to host the code.

As an AI, I provide the **source code** for the application, but I don't host the app myself. To get a shareable link and embed it on your website, you need to follow the deployment steps we discussed earlier.

Once you have deployed your app to a service like **Vercel** or **Netlify**, you will receive a URL (e.g., `https://caswa-edvisor.vercel.app`). 

### How to embed it on your website:
You can use an `iframe` to put the agent on any other website. Copy and paste this code into your existing website's HTML:

```html
<iframe 
  src="https://your-vercel-link-here.vercel.app" 
  style="width: 100%; height: 800px; border: none; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"
  allow="microphone"
  title="CASWA EdVisor">
</iframe>
```

### Important Steps to get that link:
1.  **Deploy to Vercel:** Follow the GitHub + Vercel steps I gave you in the previous message.
2.  **Enable Microphone:** Ensure you include the `allow="microphone"` attribute in the iframe code, or the voice assistant won't be able to hear the users.
3.  **Environment Variables:** Make sure your `API_KEY` is added in the Vercel dashboard settings so the AI can function.

Once you have that Vercel URL, that **is** your shareable link! You can send it to parents, students, or post it on social media.
